verdict.rationale:
ScrapingBee documents an `ai_query`/`ai_extract_rules` feature explicitly for semantic extraction, letting an LLM identify and extract fields based on natural-language intent rather than CSS/XPath selectors, distinct from the selector-based `extract_rules`. Docs explicitly recommend AI extraction 'when the desired field is semantic or the structure is irregular,' matching the story directly.

missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of extraction accuracy or reliability, and detail on how field schemas are specified/inferred without any selector input.
